usedFor: Cal ID holds bookings and form entries, and MailerLite stores each person as a subscriber through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submitted” in Cal ID, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A form entry carries a person who raised a hand, and this adds them to your email list.

watchOut: A rescheduled booking runs “Create or Update Subscriber” again, so it changes that person instead of adding a new one.
